data_description.username: The NIF/NIE you log in to datadis.es with.
data_description.authorized_nif: Only if the supplies belong to someone who has authorized you in Datadis: their NIF. Leave it empty if you are the holder.

data_description.cups: The supply to add. Those already configured are not listed.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Datadis
reauth_confirm.description: Datadis rejected the password of {username}. Type your current datadis.es password; the integration carries on where it was.

data.cycle_start_day: First day of your billing cycle (from 1 to 30)

data_description.sync_mode:
Data is synced once a day, since Datadis does not repeat a query within 24 h.

**Automatic:** if yesterday's data is not there, it tries 30 minutes later the next day, until it finds the time when Datadis has it.

**At a fixed time:** always at the time you choose.

⚠️ After changing this option, the next sync may take 24 to 48 h.
data_description.import_since: Date "Force sync" fetches Datadis's data from and rewrites the statistics from. Leave it empty for the two years Datadis serves. Useful after switching marketers, when Datadis no longer lists the earlier contract.

sync_time.title: Sync time
sync_time.description: Two syncs must be at least 24 h apart, so the next one may come 24 to 48 h after the last one.

data_description.sync_time: If Datadis does not have yesterday's data yet at that time, it will arrive with the next day's sync.

costs.title: Billing
costs.description: Enter prices **without taxes**, as they appear on your bill or contract. Electricity tax and VAT are applied afterwards, in the formulas.

data_description.p1_kw_year_eur: Price of the contracted power in the peak period, without taxes. If your bill shows €/kW·day, multiply it by 365.
data_description.p2_kw_year_eur: Price of the contracted power in the valley period, without taxes. If your bill shows €/kW·day, multiply it by 365.
data_description.meter_month_eur: Metering equipment rental, without VAT. If your bill shows it per day, multiply it by 30.
data_description.market_kw_year_eur: Retail margin per contracted kW, without taxes. The default formula adds it to the P1 power.
data_description.electricity_tax: Special electricity tax as a multiplier: 1.0511 means 5.11 %.
data_description.iva_tax: VAT as a multiplier: 1.21 means 21 % and 1.10 means 10 %.
data_description.p1_kwh_eur: Energy price in peak hours, without taxes.
data_description.p2_kwh_eur: Energy price in flat hours, without taxes.
data_description.p3_kwh_eur: Energy price in valley hours, without taxes.

formulas.title: Formulas
formulas.description: Expressions computed for every hour. Besides the values from the previous step, you can use `kwh` (the hour's consumption), `kwh_eur` (the energy price for that hour), `p1_kw` and `p2_kw` (contracted power).

confirm.title: Simulation (with taxes)
confirm.description: Simulation of the last complete month, **with taxes**. Only hours with consumption (and with a price, if you use PVPC) are billed: if the period does not cover every hour of the month, the amount will be lower than your real bill.

data.period: Simulated period (hours with data / hours in the month)

error.import_since_out_of_range: Choose a date between {earliest} and today: Datadis does not serve older data.

options.auto: Automatic: finds the time when Datadis has yesterday's data
